notes.title: Update June 2017
notes.content:
Drive By Hero's first update is now live!

[list][*]Intro voice over removed. 
[*]Max Zombie generation reduced. 
[*]Max health for Enemies halved. 
[*]Updated Gun firing sounds. 
[*]Material on machine gun edited to allow for lighting 
[*]Weapon Swap implemented. (1 = Handgun, 2 = Machine Gun) 
[*]UI element to notify the player that they got an upgrade 
[*]Removed old music
[*]Added in a music track per level[/list]

[b]Environment:[/b]
[list][*]Fog Reduced  
[*]New texture for the side of the road
[*]Planter added to base of trees 
[*]Environment light darkened 
[*]Street lamps added[/list]

We are working to fix the other issues and we want to again thank people who have participated in the game's improvement with their feedback.

The team
